{"parentUuid":"09ecabc5-e2b9-4329-8643-b3db1b7044ae","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"mcp_instructions_delta","addedNames":["plugin:context7:context7","plugin:serena:serena"],"addedBlocks":["## plugin:context7:context7\nUse this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service -- even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. This includes API syntax, configuration, version migration, library-specific debugging, setup instructions, and CLI tool usage. {"parentUuid":"446af0b0-a719-4805-b197-50f9a485ee0a","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- empirical-probe-first: Probe ALL viable strategies in a multi-option ladder BEFORE committing to one. Use when a session-plan / decision-ADR / spec presents ≥3 strategy options (e.g. \"Strategy A1/A2/A3\" or \"alternative B/C/D\") and the recommended option's source-evidence may be stale. Outputs a probe matrix per strategy + commit decision with empirical citation. Pairs with `vendor-api-probe.sh` (deterministic detection layer; SessionStart hook) and `decompose-work` (deterministic-vs-LLM split per probe). Charter promotion target — codifies L-S32-1 doctrine surfaced at S32 Track A pivot (master-plan recommended A2 vnstock alternate; empirical probe rejected A1+A2; A3 SSI direct httpx adopted instead).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- hook-diagnostics: Inspect hook event lifecycle (state machine + transcript cache + aggregator output) when triaging failed/stuck hooks or auditing self-awareness rollups. Use during sandwich-verifier review, drift investigation, or post-mortem when component-telemetry.jsonl + dispatch.jsonl + sessions-rollup.tsv need cross-checking.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- session-memory-l0-l1: Extract structured memories (L0 quick metadata + L1 deep) from a Claude Code session JSONL transcript. L0 is pure regex (file paths, commands, errors, failures incl. Vietnamese phrases, next step). L1 ships the prompt builder + response parser + 15+35 head/tail windowing — caller dispatches the LLM (no auto-invoke in Phase 0). Plus cleanText harness-stripper + TranscriptCache (mtime+size dual-check + LRU). Use when ingesting a session for memory promotion, computing what files/commands/failures the session touched, or preparing an offline LLM extraction.\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Everything here represents **agent state, decisions, plans, observations, learning**. Agents WRITE here freely (within constitution rules); humans READ here but normally do not edit.\n\nThis separation exists to prevent two failure modes from orch:\n1. **Charter drift via shared-workspace mutation** (orch CF-DOGFOOD-2)\n2. **Human cognitive overload from dense session logs** (UP02 §1.3 — \"human đối mặt hàng chục spec/document quá tải nếu không sắp xếp khoa học\")\n\nThe agent owns this directory but must keep it AUDITABLE — every artifact provenance-linked, every decision sourced.\n\n---\n\n## Subdirectories\n\n| Path | Purpose | Lifecycle |\n|---|---|---|\n| `constitution/` | **IMMUTABLE without explicit user approval**. Charter-tier rules (autonomous-protocol, model-routing, identity-scope, etc.). Track 7 produces drafts in `proposals/`; user explicit approve to move here. | Edit denied by .claude/settings.json; Write only via human approval gate |\n| `memory/project.md` | High-level project state; phase tracker; ADRs (last 5). Update on phase boundaries + architectural decisions. | Long-lived; trim to most recent decisions |\n| `memory/current-execution.md` | **THE single routing source of truth**. Active phase + active session + autonomous_mode flag + routing table. Read FIRST every session. | Long-lived; updated each session boundary |\n| `memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules from real experience (post-mortem / drift / user correction). Append-only mostly. | Long-lived |\n| `memory/decisions/` | Sequential ADRs (`NNN-<slug>.md`) + `_template.md` + `README.md` index. 12-field schema (Track 2). | Append-only; supersession via status field |\n| `memory/sessions/` | One file per session: `YYYY-MM-DD-session-N.md`. What happened, decisions made, files touched. | Append-only |\n| `memory/observations/` | Subagent return artifacts (per Track 6 spec). Each subagent writes one observation file describing what it did. | Append; cleaned periodically by aggregator |\n| `memory/checkpoints/` | Session handoff state for self-reboot (Track 5). `latest.md` is canonical pointer; timestamped historical files retained. | Append + latest.md updated each checkpoint |\n| `memory/patterns-discovered/` | Pattern mining outputs (Track 0 — DONE) + ongoing pattern catalog. | Append; significant patterns promoted to constitution |\n| `memory/drift-logs/` | Drift-check (DR1-DR12) results; runs on hook + on-demand. | Time-series append |\n| `memory/post-mortems/` | After significant failure or thesis-revoked event: what failed, root cause, prevention rule. | Append |\n| `memory/thesis-log/` | Stock-domain thesis exploration entries. Read-only for IMPL sessions. | Append + revisited per calibration |\n| `memory/sync-tracker/` | Track 8a output: Confidence Score SQLite + weights.yaml + auto-rendered `_index.md`. | Live updated by hooks |\n| `memory/self-awareness/` | Track 9 output: model × effort × thinking profile cards + known-issues + best-practices. | Live updated by Stop-hook aggregator |\n| `memory/mistake-log.md` | Track 7 deliverable: structured failure catalog. What went wrong / Root cause / Prevention rule / Severity. | Append; pre-flight read by all agents |\n| `session-plans/pending/` | Plans authored, awaiting execution. Phase 0 plan lives here. | Move to `completed/` when done |\n| `session-plans/completed/` | Executed plans; archived for reference + retrospective input. | Append |\n| `quality-reports/{deterministic,probabilistic,drift-reports}/` | Tier-1/2/3 gate outputs (CLAUDE.md § Quality Gates). | Per-run files |\n| `ubiquitous-language/` | DDD glossary + domain-mapping + drift-log. Stockforge stock-domain vocabulary. | Append; canonical via `/drill-me` |\n| `calibration/` | Empirical hit-rate data per signal type. Confidence claims MUST trace here (CLAUDE.md hard rule). | Append per thesis post-mortem |\n| `research/` | Research notes from `research-scanner` subagent dispatches (e.g., reference-repo studies). | Append |\n\n---\n\n## Contract Rules (BINDING)\n\n1. **Constitution is immutable absent explicit human approval.** `Edit/Write` to `agent-workspace/constitution/**` is in `.claude/settings.json` deny list. Track 7 writes constitution drafts to `proposals/`; user explicit approve moves them.\n\n2. **`memory/decisions/` is append-mostly + supersession-status.** Don't delete decisions; mark `status: superseded-by-D-NNN` to revoke. Sequential numbering (`001`, `002`, ...) — don't reuse numbers.\n\n3. **`current-execution.md` is the routing source-of-truth.** No skill, agent, or command may hardcode phase paths or session paths from memory; resolve via this file. Stale paths in CLAUDE.md or skills = anti-pattern.\n\n4. **Never edit `obsidian-vault/raw/`.** Immutable. Vault writes only to `wiki/`. (Established in stockforge CLAUDE.md.)\n\n5. **Provenance is mandatory.** Every decision file references its source (human prompt / spec clause / drift detection / agent inference). Every thesis cites source + as-of date (I-S2). Every confidence claim cites historical hit rate (I-S20-equivalent).\n\n6. **Agents never `git commit` in this directory unless user explicitly requests.** Stage only.\n\n7. **`patterns-discovered/` artifacts are READ-ONLY for production code.** Patterns must be promoted to constitution / skills / hook scripts before becoming binding. (Otherwise they're informal notes, not contracts.)\n\n---\n\n## Reading Priority for Agent\n\nPer `agent-workspace/constitution/autonomous-protocol.md` (Track 7) and stockforge `CLAUDE.md` § Session Protocol:\n\n1. **`memory/current-execution.md`** — first; resolve active track\n2. **`memory/project.md`** — project state\n3. **`memory/checkpoints/latest.md`** if a recent checkpoint exists (within last 24h) — resume context\n4. **`memory/agent-notes.md`** — learned rules\n5. **`memory/mistake-log.md`** — pre-flight failure catalog\n6. **Last 3 files in `memory/sessions/`** — recent context\n7. **`session-plans/pending/<active-plan>.md`** — current plan\n8. **Relevant constitution files** as task demands (don't load all every session)\n9. **Relevant skills + agents + commands** as task demands\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Patterns to Avoid\n\n(From `memory/patterns-discovered/SYNTHESIS.md` § 6, full catalog 23 items. Highest-priority for this directory:)\n\n- **AP-1 Same-agent self-review** — never review your own implementation; dispatch fresh-context verifier\n- **AP-2 Self-track wind-down** — `.transcript-tokens` real-transcript is authoritative, not LLM self-track\n- **AP-5 Charter-coherence defer overriding user-CRITICAL** — re-read all `user_prompt/*` at every phase entry; never silently defer USER-CRITICAL\n- **AP-7 Performative SC ticking** — defer with explicit prerequisites > fire vacuous proposals\n- **AP-8 Pre-staged work causing checkpoint drift** — update `current-execution.md` immediately on task complete, not session-end\n- **AP-17 Identity drift** — stockforge is AI-first VN stock advisory; not generic financial framework (see `constitution/identity-scope.md` once Track 7 ships)\n- **AP-23 Continuous LLM-Guardian** — deterministic hooks = Guardian; LLM Guardian only at session-end aggregation\n\n---\n\n## Connection to human-workspace/\n\nThis directory is the agent's domain. Human's domain is `human-workspace/`. The two communicate through:\n- Human → Agent: `human-workspace/user_prompt/`, `human-workspace/decisions/`\n- Agent → Human: `human-workspace/notifications/`, `human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/`\n- Bidirectional: `human-workspace/q-and-a/answered/` — agent writes pending; either human or agent (per Auto-mv rule below) moves resolved bundles to answered/\n- Audit trail: this directory's `memory/decisions/` references `human-workspace/` source files via path pointers\n\n**Auto-mv rule (HH-E.2 — D-031 ratification, 2026-05-05)**: Agent MAY mv a bundle from `q-and-a/pending/` to `q-and-a/answered/` IFF ALL of the following hold:\n\n1. **Frontmatter signal**: bundle frontmatter `status:` field value starts with one of: `answered-`, `closed-`, `resolved-`. Examples already in repo: `answered-via-chat`, `answered-via-AskUserQuestion`, `answered-2026-05-04-via-chat`. Detection is deterministic (head -20 of file + grep `^status:`).\n2. **No human-veto signal**: bundle frontmatter has NO `wait_until:` ISO-8601 timestamp greater than current epoch — if present, agent MUST defer mv until that timestamp passes. Allows human to override auto-mv per-bundle without contract amendment.\n3. **No global pause**: file `human-workspace/q-and-a/.auto-mv-paused` does NOT exist — global kill switch for the auto-mv mechanism (single empty file presence pauses all auto-mv).\n4. **Hook validation**: the mv is performed by `scripts/hooks/qa-pending-auto-mover.sh` (Stop hook). Direct manual `mv` invocation by agent (e.g. via Bash tool) is STILL forbidden — only the validated hook path is authorized.\n\nAgent never writes to `human-workspace/` outside the designated `q-and-a/pending/` write channel + the auto-mv rule above + `notifications/` write channel (existing).\n","contentDiffersFromDisk":false},"displayPath":"agent-workspace\\CLAUDE.md"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"1e4515d3-44db-4b27-814a-2a0c8ac2b84f","timestamp":"2026-05-05T13:48:12.143Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"9e3a6444-e778-4075-abe6-61ed2e28a83c","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

System refuses to render thesis without it.\n45\t**Anti-example**: Thesis with bull case + risks section that says \"market volatility, regulatory changes\" (boilerplate)\n46\t**Correct example**: Bear case with specific points like \"Q3 inventory turnover dropped 23% YoY suggesting demand weakness\", \"Major competitor X launched directly competitive product Y in March 2026\", \"Net working capital deterioration of 15% indicates cash flow strain\"\n47\t**Severity**: high\n48\t**Auto-detect**: yes — bear case length + specificity check\n49\t\n50\t### 2026-04-23: Confidence Requires Calibration Data\n51\t**Context**: LLM \"confidence\" is qualitative; user reads numerical values\n52\t**Rule**: Any \"X% confidence\" or \"high/medium/low confidence\" claim must trace to historical hit rate from calibration database. Empirical investigation: that fix advice is WRONG for this specific hook because the grep is **content-search** of transcript JSONL narration (mid-JSON-line text content embedded inside `\"text\":\"...\"` values), NOT **header-parse** of structured markdown documents. Anchoring `^` would BREAK detection because each JSONL line begins `{\"role\":\"assistant\",...` so `^S` never matches assistant text content. Existing P6 firing-test case (`\"S52 entry is the next session start.\"`) directly demonstrates this: it currently PASSES; with `^` anchor it would fail.\n\n**Rule**: When applying L-S54-2 reframed retrofit recipe to a hook flagged by Check 8 (L-S53-2), FIRST categorize the grep usage:\n1. **Header-parse** target: structured markdown / config / log line → grep target is a file path argument (e.g. `grep -E '^## S' \"$EXEC_FILE\"`); document content has predictable line structure with anchors. → Apply `^` anchor as advised.\n2. **Content-search** target: transcript JSONL / multi-line text variable / piped-from-printf → grep target is `printf '%s' \"$VAR\" | grep ...`; content is free-form text mid-line with no consistent anchors. → Anchoring `^` BREAKS detection. Apply alternative refinement: tighten alternation structure (e.g. `entry is.{0,15}next session` instead of `entry is.{0,30}next`); add archive-prose negative test cases proving robustness.\n\n**Categorization heuristic**: inspect grep TARGET (last positional argument):\n- File path or `< file` redirect → header-parse → anchor advice valid\n- `printf|cat|tail|head ... | grep` (piped variable) → content-search → anchor advice often invalid\n\n**Suppression mechanism**: when categorization concludes false-positive on fix advice, ratify via inline source comment near the grep (cite L-S53-2 + KI-S55-1 + reference to firing-test control case demonstrating robustness). Lint flag persists in surface log (acceptable — soft-warn surface; agent triages per categorization).\n\n**Anti-example** (S55 PoC): blindly applying `^` anchor advice to autonomous-stop-watchdog.sh:64 would have regressed P6 firing-test case (P6 specifically exercises mid-JSON-line `S52 entry is...` matching).\n\n**Correct example** (S55 PoC): inline comment ratifying false-positive categorization + 2 archive-prose control cases (C5 + C6) added to firing-test proving detector robust against `S<N> NEXT` archive-style narration without anchor.\n\n**Severity**: medium (recipe gap — without this step, L-S54-2 batch retrofit risks false-fix on content-search greps; degraded detection capability).\n**Auto-detect**: partial — Check 8 flags both true-positives and false-positives; triage requires LLM categorization step (cheap once recipe is encoded).\n**Where tracked**:\n- This entry (L-S55-1)\n- `scripts/hooks/autonomous-stop-watchdog.sh` inline comment near line 64 references this lesson\n- `scripts/hooks/firing-tests/autonomous-stop-watchdog-fire-test.sh` control cases C5 + C6 demonstrate robustness empirically\n- `agent-workspace/quality-reports/deterministic/2026-05-05-S55-autonomous-stop-watchdog-poc-retrofit.log`\n\n---\n\n### KI-S55-1 — bash-hook-lint Check 8 over-broad: flags content-search greps where `^` anchor doesn't apply (deferred refinement)\n**Date**: 2026-05-05\n**Origin**: S55 PoC spot-check of autonomous-stop-watchdog.sh — Check 8 correctly identifies \"looks like positional-marker pattern\" but doesn't distinguish content-search context (anchoring breaks) from header-parse context (anchoring helps). 1 of 4 S54 production-smoke L-S53-2 candidates is content-search false-positive (autonomous-stop-watchdog.sh); 3 are likely real header-parse bugs (promotion-cycle-trigger.sh + session-start-bootstrap.sh + stale-prompt-detector.sh) — pending S56 batch verification.\n\n**Status**: deferred refinement — accepted trade-off. {"parentUuid":"ef016c6c-d2ea-40d3-af5b-60718c2f8b1c","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e96223df-a0b2-45d9-9645-2c18d347f0b7","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01VxdNQfsqW5L8M55CJuayo3","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t#!/usr/bin/env bash\n2\t# promotion-cycle-trigger.sh — S35 D4 META-fix (per L-S35-1 / BP-S35-1 / decision-discipline Rule 4a draft).\n3\t# Fires `promote-rule` subagent dispatch reminder when:\n4\t#   (a) ≥5 sessions passed since last `agent-workspace/memory/observations/promote-rule-S*.md`, OR\n5\t#   (b) Phase boundary detected (current-execution.md `Phase` field changed since last run).\n6\t# Hard-block at 8 sessions / phase-cross without promotion observation.\n7\t#\n8\t# Wire as Stop hook in .claude/settings.json once L-S11-1 portability check (Phase 0 = bash+POSIX) passes.\n9\t# Output goes to stderr + drift-log; non-zero exit only at hard-block.\n10\tset -euo pipefail\n11\ttrap 'exit 0' ERR\n12\t\n13\tPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\n14\tEXEC_FILE=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\"\n15\tOBS_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/observations\"\n16\tLOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.promotion-cycle.log\"\n17\tmkdir -p \"$(dirname \"$LOG\")\"\n18\t\n19\t[ ! -f \"$EXEC_FILE\" ] && exit 0\n20\t\n21\t# Latest session number — scoped to ## SXX section headers (per L-S51-1 fix at S51).\n22\t# Prior bug (M-S51-1): grepped for `**Session N**:` literal which never appears in current-execution.md\n23\t# (file uses `## S50 — ...` header format). If user wants to revisit, treat as new scope; otherwise surface closure status (cite the linked decision) before re-doing work.\"\n    fi\n  done\nfi\n\n# === D-NNN reference check ===\nif [ -d \"$DECISIONS_DIR\" ]; then\n  for ref in $(printf '%s' \"$USER_PROMPT\" | grep -oE 'D-[0-9]+' | sort -u); do\n    NUM=$(printf '%s' \"$ref\" | sed 's/D-0*//; s/^$/0/')\n    NUM_PADDED=$(printf '%03d' \"$NUM\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"$NUM\")\n    DEC_FILE=$(ls \"$DECISIONS_DIR\"/${NUM_PADDED}-*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)\n    if [ -n \"$DEC_FILE\" ]; then\n      DEC_STATUS=$(awk '/^status:/ { gsub(/^status:[[:space:]]*/,\"\"); print; exit }' \"$DEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || true)\n      if printf '%s' \"$DEC_STATUS\" | grep -qiE '^(ACCEPTED|SUPERSEDED|REJECTED)$'; then\n        add_warning \"- $ref already in terminal status ($DEC_STATUS per $DEC_FILE). Re-opening requires explicit user pick + new ADR (D-NNN+1 superseding) — do not silently re-decide.\"\n      fi\n    fi\n  done\nfi\n\n# === Track N(.Nx) reference check ===\nif [ -f \"$EXEC_FILE\" ]; then\n  for ref in $(printf '%s' \"$USER_PROMPT\" | grep -oE 'Track [0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+[a-z]*(\\.[0-9]+)?)?' | sort -u); do\n    TRACK_NUM=$(printf '%s' \"$ref\" | sed 's/^Track //')\n    DONE_LINE=$(grep -E \"Track ${TRACK_NUM}.*(✅|DONE|done)\" \"$EXEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)\n    if [ -n \"$DONE_LINE\" ]; then\n      add_warning \"- $ref is marked DONE in current-execution.md. If user wants amendments, surface what shipped before re-implementing.\"\n    fi\n  done\nfi\n\n# === S<N> session reference check (only flag if session log exists; means session closed) ===\nSESSIONS_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/sessions\"\nif [ -d \"$SESSIONS_DIR\" ]; then\n  for ref in $(printf '%s' \"$USER_PROMPT\" | grep -oE '\\bS[0-9]+\\b' | sort -u); do\n    SNUM=$(printf '%s' \"$ref\" | sed 's/^S//')\n    LOG_EXISTS=$(ls \"$SESSIONS_DIR\"/*-session-${SNUM}*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)\n    if [ -n \"$LOG_EXISTS\" ]; then\n      add_warning \"- $ref has a session log ($LOG_EXISTS) — session closed. If user wants to amend its outputs, surface what shipped first.\"\n    fi\n  done\nfi\n\n# === Emit additionalContext if any warnings ===\nif [ -n \"$WARNINGS\" ]; then\n  WARN_BLOCK=\"STALE-PROMPT DETECTOR (auto-injected; deterministic hook):\nThe user's prompt references work items that appear CLOSED in current state. Before acting:\n$WARNINGS\n\nRecommendation: Briefly surface the closure status (1-2 sentences citing the decision/session) before doing any action. If user picks 'redo' explicitly, then proceed with new work. Per UP-06 NO-Silent-Default rule + UP-07 follow-up RCA.\"\n\n  node -e \"\nconst ctx = process.argv[1];\nprocess.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({\n  hookSpecificOutput: {\n    hookEventName: 'UserPromptSubmit',\n    additionalContext: ctx\n  }\n}));\n\" \"$WARN_BLOCK\" 2>/dev/null || true\n\n  echo \"[$(date -Iseconds)] stale-prompt-detector: WARNING emitted for prompt (refs detected)\" >> \"$HOOK_LOG\"\nelse\n  echo \"[$(date -Iseconds)] stale-prompt-detector: clean (no stale refs)\" >> \"$HOOK_LOG\"\nfi\n\nexit 0\n","numLines":117,"startLine":1,"totalLines":117}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"52fc2e99-6198-4fd2-84a8-7ee5f9800554","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"9e3a6444-e778-4075-abe6-61ed2e28a83c","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

LATEST_SESSION was always 0; SESSION_DELTA was always\n# negative; hard-block + soft-warn rules never escalated despite 20+ fires/day.\n# Real format: `## S<NN>[a-z]? — <title>` headers (e.g. `## S50 — Phase 3.5 master-plan authored`,\n# `## S49b — Tier 1 archive sweep`). Also handle subordinate variants (S49a, S49b, S50-pre).\nLATEST_SESSION=$(grep -oE '^## S[0-9]+' \"$EXEC_FILE\" | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | sort -n | tail -1 || echo 0)\n[ -z \"$LATEST_SESSION\" ] && LATEST_SESSION=0\n\n# Latest phase number.\nLATEST_PHASE=$(grep -oE '\\*\\*Phase\\*\\*: [0-9]+' \"$EXEC_FILE\" | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+' || echo 0)\n\n# Find latest promote-rule observation file.\nLAST_PROMOTE_FILE=$(ls -t \"$OBS_DIR\"/promote-rule-S*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)\nLAST_PROMOTE_SESSION=0\nLAST_PROMOTE_PHASE=0\nif [ -n \"$LAST_PROMOTE_FILE\" ]; then\n  LAST_PROMOTE_SESSION=$(basename \"$LAST_PROMOTE_FILE\" | grep -oE 'S[0-9]+' | tr -d 'S' || echo 0)\n  LAST_PROMOTE_PHASE=$(grep -oE 'phase: [0-9]+' \"$LAST_PROMOTE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+' || echo 0)\nfi\n\nSESSION_DELTA=$((LATEST_SESSION - LAST_PROMOTE_SESSION))\nPHASE_CHANGED=0\n[ \"$LATEST_PHASE\" -gt \"$LAST_PROMOTE_PHASE\" ] && PHASE_CHANGED=1\n\nprintf '[%s] promotion-cycle-trigger: latest_session=%s last_promote=S%s delta=%s latest_phase=%s last_phase=%s phase_changed=%s\\n' \\\n  \"$(date -Iseconds)\" \"$LATEST_SESSION\" \"$LAST_PROMOTE_SESSION\" \"$SESSION_DELTA\" \"$LATEST_PHASE\" \"$LAST_PROMOTE_PHASE\" \"$PHASE_CHANGED\" >> \"$LOG\"\n\n# Hard-block: ≥8 sessions OR phase-changed without promote.\nif [ \"$SESSION_DELTA\" -ge 8 ] || { [ \"$PHASE_CHANGED\" -eq 1 ] && [ \"$SESSION_DELTA\" -ge 1 ]; }; then\n  printf '[%s] HARD-BLOCK promotion-cycle: delta=%s phase_changed=%s\\n' \\\n    \"$(date -Iseconds)\" \"$SESSION_DELTA\" \"$PHASE_CHANGED\" >> \"$LOG\"\n  echo \"promotion-cycle HARD-BLOCK: ≥8 sessions OR phase boundary crossed without promote-rule run. Dispatch promote-rule subagent before next session-end.\" >&2\n  exit 0  # non-blocking; advisory only — hard-block via Stop-hook decision JSON in v2\nfi\n\n# Soft-warn: ≥5 sessions.\nif [ \"$SESSION_DELTA\" -ge 5 ]; then\n  printf '[%s] SOFT-WARN promotion-cycle: delta=%s — recommend running promote-rule subagent\\n' \\\n    \"$(date -Iseconds)\" \"$SESSION_DELTA\" >> \"$LOG\"\n  echo \"promotion-cycle SOFT-WARN: ${SESSION_DELTA} sessions since last promote-rule run; recommend dispatching subagent.\" >&2\nfi\n\nexit 0\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":35,"oldLines":6,"newStart":35,"newLines":15,"lines":[" LAST_PROMOTE_SESSION=0"," LAST_PROMOTE_PHASE=0"," if [ -n \"$LAST_PROMOTE_FILE\" ]; then","+  # NOTE on L-S53-2 lint advice (S56 categorization, KI-S55-1 family):","+  #   bash-hook-lint Check 8 flags `grep -oE 'S[0-9]+'` here as unanchored","+  #   positional-marker → suggests `^` anchor. adapted paths (phase-1-core.md → docs/DAY_1_CHECKLIST.md) +\n# removed orch worktree sweep + added queued-grill-master fire_when scan.\nset -euo pipefail\ntrap 'exit 0' ERR\n\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nCHECKPOINT_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/checkpoints\"\nLATEST=\"$CHECKPOINT_DIR/latest.md\"\n\nmkdir -p \"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\nHOOK_LOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.session-hooks.log\"\n\nPAYLOAD=$(cat)\nSOURCE=$(printf '%s' \"$PAYLOAD\" | node -e \"\nlet s=''; process.stdin.on('data',c=>s+=c);\nprocess.stdin.on('end',()=>{ try { console.log(JSON.parse(s).source||''); } catch { console.log(''); } });\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"\")\n\necho \"[$(date -Iseconds)] SessionStart-bootstrap source=$SOURCE latest_exists=$([ -f \"$LATEST\" ] && echo yes || echo no)\" >> \"$HOOK_LOG\"\n\ncase \"$SOURCE\" in\n  startup|resume|clear) ;;\n  *) exit 0 ;;\nesac\n\n[ -f \"$LATEST\" ] || exit 0\n\n# Reset once-only watchdog markers so new session has clean budget slate.\nrm -f \"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.cliff-fired\" \\\n      \"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.wind-down\" \\\n      \"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.wind-down-fired\"\n\n# Proactive parse-check session-self-reboot.ps1 on Windows so encoding bugs surface\n# BEFORE wind-down hits (avoid silent reboot block).\ncase \"$(uname -s)\" in\n  MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*)\n    PS_SCRIPT=\"$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/session-self-reboot.ps1\"\n    if [ -f \"$PS_SCRIPT\" ] && command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n      PS_SCRIPT_WIN=\"$(cygpath -w \"$PS_SCRIPT\" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' \"$PS_SCRIPT\")\"\n      PARSE_OUT=$(powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command \\\n        \"try { \\$null = [scriptblock]::Create((Get-Content -Raw -Path '$PS_SCRIPT_WIN')); 'PARSE_OK' } catch { 'PARSE_FAIL: ' + \\$_.Exception.Message }\" \\\n        2>&1 | tr -d '\\r' | head -1 || echo \"PARSE_FAIL: powershell.exe invocation failed\")\n      if ! printf '%s' \"$PARSE_OUT\" | grep -q '^PARSE_OK'; then\n        printf 'AUTO-REBOOT FAILED at %s (SessionStart proactive parse-check)\\nReason: PowerShell parser cannot load session-self-reboot.ps1.\\nParse output: %s\\nFile: %s\\nAction: investigate scripts/session-self-reboot.ps1.\\n' \\\n          \"$(date -Iseconds)\" \"$PARSE_OUT\" \"$PS_SCRIPT_WIN\" \\\n          > \"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.auto-reboot-FAILED\"\n        echo \"[$(date -Iseconds)] SessionStart-bootstrap PROACTIVE PARSE-CHECK FAILED: $PARSE_OUT\" >> \"$HOOK_LOG\"\n      else\n        echo \"[$(date -Iseconds)] SessionStart-bootstrap parse-check OK on session-self-reboot.ps1\" >> \"$HOOK_LOG\"\n      fi\n    fi\n    ;;\nesac\n\n# === Queued-grill master fire_when scan (UP-06 doctrine, S3 Track 5 deliverable) ===\n# Reads queued-grill-master.md; emits notification line for each entry whose fire_when matches\n# the active phase/track. Agent decides timing — hook surfaces, doesn't auto-fire AskUserQuestion.\nQUEUED_GRILL_FILE=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/observations/queued-grill-master.md\"\nEXEC_FILE=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\"\nif [ -f \"$QUEUED_GRILL_FILE\" ] && [ -f \"$EXEC_FILE\" ]; then\n  ACTIVE_PHASE=$(awk -F': ' '/^\\*\\*Phase\\*\\*/ {print $2; exit}' \"$EXEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || true)\n  # ACTIVE_SESSION: extract LARGEST `## S<N>` header — real file format (per L-S51-1 / M-S52-1 fix at S53).\n  # Prior bug (M-S52-1): awked for `^**Session N**` literal which never appears in real file\n  # → ACTIVE_SESSION silently empty → queued-grill awk matcher (line ~75 below) `sess != \"\"`\n  # branch never executed → session-token fire_when entries (e.g. \"S20+\", \"S52\", \"S5 Track 7\")\n  # silently never fired in production. Track-based matching kept working (ACTIVE_TRACK line below).\n  ACTIVE_SESSION_NUM=$(grep -oE '^## S[0-9]+' \"$EXEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | sort -n | tail -1 || true)\n  ACTIVE_SESSION=\"${ACTIVE_SESSION_NUM:+S$ACTIVE_SESSION_NUM}\"\n  ACTIVE_TRACK=$(grep -oE 'Track [0-9]+' \"$EXEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)\n  GRILL_QUEUE_LOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.queued-grill-fired.log\"\n  # Match entries whose fire_when contains active session \"S<N>\" or track \"Track <N>\" tokens.\n  awk -v phase=\"$ACTIVE_PHASE\" -v sess=\"$ACTIVE_SESSION\" -v track=\"$ACTIVE_TRACK\" '\n    /^### Q-/ { qid=$2; in_entry=1; fire_when=\"\"; next }\n    in_entry && /^- \\*\\*fire_when\\*\\*:/ {\n      sub(/^- \\*\\*fire_when\\*\\*: */,\"\"); fire_when=$0;\n      match_hit=0;\n      if (sess  != \"\" && index(fire_when, sess)  > 0) match_hit=1\n      if (track != \"\" && index(fire_when, track) > 0) match_hit=1\n      if (match_hit) print \"[queued-grill] \" qid \" fire_when=\" fire_when\n    }\n    /^### / && !/^### Q-/ { in_entry=0 }\n  ' \"$QUEUED_GRILL_FILE\" >> \"$GRILL_QUEUE_LOG\" 2>/dev/null || true\nfi\n\n# Build resume context.\nCONTEXT=\"STOCKFORGE AUTONOMOUS RESUME: SessionStart hook fired. \\\nRead these in order before any tool call: \\\n(1) $LATEST [handoff checkpoint with current phase/track/next_action], \\\n(2) $PROJECT_DIR/CLAUDE.md [project rules: NO LLM math, every claim has source+as-of, deterministic risk, multi-perspective adversarial], \\\n(3) $PROJECT_DIR/PROJECT_CHARTER.md [immutable invariants I-S1..I-S35], \\\n(4) $PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md [routing + active phase/track], \\\n(5) $PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/observations/queued-grill-master.md [check fire_when triggers matching active context], \\\n(6) Active session plan via current-execution.md routing table. \\\nThen resume at checkpoint's next_action. Do NOT commit (CLAUDE.md hard rule). For Agent dispatches: run_in_background=true.\"\n\nnode -e \"\nconst ctx = process.argv[1];\nprocess.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({\n  hookSpecificOutput: {\n    hookEventName: 'SessionStart',\n    additionalContext: ctx\n  }\n}));\n\" \"$CONTEXT\"\n\necho \"[$(date -Iseconds)] SessionStart-bootstrap injected additionalContext\" >> \"$HOOK_LOG\"\n\nprintf 'ready_at=%s\\nsession_id=%s\\nsource=%s\\n' \"$(date -Iseconds)\" \"${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown}\" \"$SOURCE\" \\\n  > \"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.session-ready\"\n\n# Spawn DETACHED continue-injector that SendKeys \"continue\" to fresh TUI.\n# GATING (S8 revision per user \"no continue, why? fix\" complaint, supersedes S7 unconditional gate):\n#   source=clear  → fire UNCONDITIONALLY (explicit user /clear → expects checkpoint resume; race risk low)\n#   source=resume → fire UNCONDITIONALLY (user invoked claude --resume → expects continuation)\n#   source=startup → gated by autonomous_mode=true (fresh launch; user likely typing own prompt → race risk high)\n# stale-prompt-detector.sh line 26 short-circuits literal \"continue\" prompt → no false stale-warning firing.\nEXEC_FILE=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\"\nAUTONOMOUS_MODE=\"false\"\nif [ -f \"$EXEC_FILE\" ]; then\n  AUTONOMOUS_MODE=$(awk -F': ' '/^\\*\\*autonomous_mode\\*\\*/ {print $2; exit}' \"$EXEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null \\\n    | awk '{print $1}' | tr -d '*' || echo \"false\")\n  AUTONOMOUS_MODE=\"${AUTONOMOUS_MODE:-false}\"\nfi\n\nSHOULD_FIRE_INJECTOR=\"false\"\nFIRE_REASON=\"\"\ncase \"$SOURCE\" in\n  clear)\n    # HH-H.3 (S48m): gate clear-branch by autonomous_mode + STOCKFORGE_FORCE_CONTINUE_ON_CLEAR\n    # override. Pre-S48m unconditionally fired — but a user-driven /clear with\n    # autonomous_mode=false (post-Phase-2.5 ratification gate) would race against\n    # the human typing their own first prompt. Override env var keeps the explicit-\n    # user-flow path fast.\n    if [ \"${STOCKFORGE_FORCE_CONTINUE_ON_CLEAR:-0}\" = \"1\" ]; then\n      SHOULD_FIRE_INJECTOR=\"true\"\n      FIRE_REASON=\"source=clear + STOCKFORGE_FORCE_CONTINUE_ON_CLEAR=1 (override)\"\n    elif [ \"$AUTONOMOUS_MODE\" = \"true\" ]; then\n      SHOULD_FIRE_INJECTOR=\"true\"\n      FIRE_REASON=\"source=clear + autonomous_mode=true\"\n    else\n      FIRE_REASON=\"source=clear + autonomous_mode=false (HH-H.3 gate; user-driven /clear → race risk)\"\n    fi\n    ;;\n  resume)\n    SHOULD_FIRE_INJECTOR=\"true\"\n    FIRE_REASON=\"source=resume (user invoked claude --resume)\"\n    ;;\n  startup)\n    if [ \"$AUTONOMOUS_MODE\" = \"true\" ]; then\n      SHOULD_FIRE_INJECTOR=\"true\"\n      FIRE_REASON=\"source=startup + autonomous_mode=true\"\n    else\n      FIRE_REASON=\"source=startup + autonomous_mode=false (race risk with user typing)\"\n    fi\n    ;;\nesac\n\nif [ \"$SHOULD_FIRE_INJECTOR\" = \"true\" ]; then\n  case \"$(uname -s)\" in\n    MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*)\n      PS_SCRIPT=\"$(cygpath -w \"$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/continue-injector.ps1\")\"\n      powershell.exe -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass \\\n        -Command \"Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden -FilePath powershell.exe -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File','$PS_SCRIPT'\" \\\n        >/dev/null 2>&1 &\n      disown 2>/dev/null || true\n      ;;\n    Darwin)\n      nohup osascript -e 'delay 2.5' \\\n        -e 'tell application \"System Events\" to keystroke \"continue\"' \\\n        -e 'tell application \"System Events\" to key code 36' \\\n        >/dev/null 2>&1 &\n      disown 2>/dev/null || true\n      ;;\n    Linux)\n      if command -v xdotool >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n        ( sleep 2.5; xdotool type --delay 30 \"continue\"; xdotool key Return ) \\\n          >/dev/null 2>&1 &\n        disown 2>/dev/null || true\n      fi\n      ;;\n  esac\n  echo \"[$(date -Iseconds)] SessionStart-bootstrap spawned continue-injector ($FIRE_REASON)\" >> \"$HOOK_LOG\"\nelse\n  echo \"[$(date -Iseconds)] SessionStart-bootstrap SKIPPED continue-injector ($FIRE_REASON)\" >> \"$HOOK_LOG\"\nfi\n\nexit 0\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":70,"oldLines":6,"newStart":70,"newLines":22,"lines":["   # silently never fired in production. If user wants amendments, surface what shipped before re-implementing.\"\n    fi\n  done\nfi\n\n# === S<N> session reference check (only flag if session log exists; means session closed) ===\nSESSIONS_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/sessions\"\nif [ -d \"$SESSIONS_DIR\" ]; then\n  for ref in $(printf '%s' \"$USER_PROMPT\" | grep -oE '\\bS[0-9]+\\b' | sort -u); do\n    SNUM=$(printf '%s' \"$ref\" | sed 's/^S//')\n    LOG_EXISTS=$(ls \"$SESSIONS_DIR\"/*-session-${SNUM}*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)\n    if [ -n \"$LOG_EXISTS\" ]; then\n      add_warning \"- $ref has a session log ($LOG_EXISTS) — session closed. If user wants amendments, surface what shipped before re-implementing.\"\n    fi\n  done < <(printf '%s' \"$USER_PROMPT\" | grep -oE 'Track [0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+[a-z]*(\\.[0-9]+)?)?' | sort -u)\nfi","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# stale-prompt-detector.sh — UserPromptSubmit hook detecting \"stale-prompt vs current-state\" mismatch.\n# Created S7 (2026-04-29) per UP-07 follow-up RCA: post-/clear user prompts may reference work\n# already CLOSED in checkpoint state (e.g., \"continue UP-07\" when UP-07 closed-by-D-004 in S6).\n# Without this hook the agent re-fires AskUserQuestion to clarify, blocking autonomous flow.\n# Hook is NON-BLOCKING: only injects additionalContext warning. Agent decides action.\n# Wired as UserPromptSubmit in .claude/settings.local.json (after invariants-injector).\nset -uo pipefail\ntrap 'exit 0' ERR\n\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nINTAKE_LOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/up-intake-log.md\"\nDECISIONS_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/decisions\"\nEXEC_FILE=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\"\nHOOK_LOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.session-hooks.log\"\n\nmkdir -p \"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\n\nPAYLOAD=\"$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)\"\nUSER_PROMPT=\"$(printf '%s' \"$PAYLOAD\" | node -e \"\nlet s=''; process.stdin.on('data',c=>s+=c);\nprocess.stdin.on('end',()=>{ try { console.log(JSON.parse(s).prompt || JSON.parse(s).user_message || ''); } catch { console.log(''); } });\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"\")\"\n\n# Skip on empty / trivial prompts.\nif [ -z \"$USER_PROMPT\" ]; then exit 0; fi\nif printf '%s' \"$USER_PROMPT\" | head -c 40 | grep -qiE '^[[:space:]]*(continue|ok|yes|y|n|no|done)[[:space:]]*$'; then\n  exit 0\nfi\n\nWARNINGS=\"\"\n\nadd_warning() {\n  if [ -z \"$WARNINGS\" ]; then\n    WARNINGS=\"$1\"\n  else\n    WARNINGS=\"$WARNINGS\n$1\"\n  fi\n}\n\n# === UP-NN reference check ===\nif [ -f \"$INTAKE_LOG\" ]; then\n  for ref in $(printf '%s' \"$USER_PROMPT\" | grep -oE 'UP-[0-9]+' | sort -u); do\n    STATUS=$(awk -v ref=\"$ref\" '\n      $0 ~ \"up_id: \" ref \"$\" { in_entry=1; next }\n      in_entry && /^- up_id:/ { in_entry=0 }\n      in_entry && /^[[:space:]]*status:/ { gsub(/^[[:space:]]*status:[[:space:]]*/,\"\"); print; exit }\n    ' \"$INTAKE_LOG\" 2>/dev/null || true)\n    if [ -n \"$STATUS\" ] && printf '%s' \"$STATUS\" | grep -qE '^closed-'; then\n      add_warning \"- $ref is CLOSED ($STATUS per up-intake-log.md). If user wants to revisit, treat as new scope; otherwise surface closure status (cite the linked decision) before re-doing work.\"\n    fi\n  done\nfi\n\n# === D-NNN reference check ===\nif [ -d \"$DECISIONS_DIR\" ]; then\n  for ref in $(printf '%s' \"$USER_PROMPT\" | grep -oE 'D-[0-9]+' | sort -u); do\n    NUM=$(printf '%s' \"$ref\" | sed 's/D-0*//; s/^$/0/')\n    NUM_PADDED=$(printf '%03d' \"$NUM\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"$NUM\")\n    DEC_FILE=$(ls \"$DECISIONS_DIR\"/${NUM_PADDED}-*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)\n    if [ -n \"$DEC_FILE\" ]; then\n      DEC_STATUS=$(awk '/^status:/ { gsub(/^status:[[:space:]]*/,\"\"); print; exit }' \"$DEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || true)\n      if printf '%s' \"$DEC_STATUS\" | grep -qiE '^(ACCEPTED|SUPERSEDED|REJECTED)$'; then\n        add_warning \"- $ref already in terminal status ($DEC_STATUS per $DEC_FILE). Re-opening requires explicit user pick + new ADR (D-NNN+1 superseding) — do not silently re-decide.\"\n      fi\n    fi\n  done\nfi\n\n# === Track N(.Nx) reference check ===\n# NOTE on L-S53-2 lint advice (S56 categorization, KI-S55-1 family):\n#   bash-hook-lint Check 8 flags `grep -oE 'Track [0-9]+...'` here as unanchored\n#   positional-marker → suggests `^` anchor. WRONG advice: target is `$USER_PROMPT`\n#   piped variable holding free-form user input where \"Track 5\" can appear anywhere.\n#   Anchoring `^Track [0-9]+` would only match prompts STARTING with \"Track <N>\"\n#   (e.g. user types \"remind me about Track 5\" → mid-prompt → anchored grep\n#   misses). Categorization: content-search of user-input text (NOT header-parse).\n#   Per L-S55-1: ratify false-positive via this comment.\nif [ -f \"$EXEC_FILE\" ]; then\n  for ref in $(printf '%s' \"$USER_PROMPT\" | grep -oE 'Track [0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+[a-z]*(\\.[0-9]+)?)?' | sort -u); do\n    TRACK_NUM=$(printf '%s' \"$ref\" | sed 's/^Track //')\n    DONE_LINE=$(grep -E \"Track ${TRACK_NUM}.*(✅|DONE|done)\" \"$EXEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)\n    if [ -n \"$DONE_LINE\" ]; then\n      add_warning \"- $ref is marked DONE in current-execution.md. If user wants amendments, surface what shipped before re-implementing.\"\n    fi\n  done\nfi\n\n# === S<N> session reference check (only flag if session log exists; means session closed) ===\n# NOTE on L-S53-2 lint advice (S56 categorization, KI-S55-1 family):\n#   bash-hook-lint Check 8 flags `grep -oE '\\bS[0-9]+\\b'` here as unanchored\n#   positional-marker → suggests `^` anchor. WRONG advice: target is `$USER_PROMPT`\n#   user-input where \"S52\" can appear mid-prompt.
